req.title: Reject negative skip
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the skip parameter is negative.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-006 requires HTTP 422 when skip < 0. The violation was test[3] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. EP (Equivalence Partitioning) is valid for negative tests when the value is a representative of an invalid equivalence class. However, the rule-based checker flags negative+EP as a logical conflict. Fix: change test[3] heuristic from EP to NEG, which is the correct heuristic for negative/invalid-input tests. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_skip_zero_returns_200_with_all_tasks
preconditions: App is running in-process with TestClient
expected: Response body is a JSON list of 20 tasks
First task id is 1 with title 'Read chapter 5'
trace: R-TASK-006: skip=0 is the minimum valid value (ge=0), must not be rejected
BVA: tests the exact lower boundary of the valid partition
Catches mutations that change ge=0 to gt=0 or ge=1
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0")
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert isinstance(body, list)
assert len(body) == 20
assert body[0]["id"] == 1
assert body[0]["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
assert body[0]["completed"] == True
